item.description: The Origins of Science Fiction Remnant. How Science Fiction Remnant began—from sci-fi fandom & deep questions to building a global community.

item.title: Healing Magic and Science: A Scientific Exploration
item.description: Explore the scientific exploration of healing magic, where medicine, magology, and human ingenuity shape a world where magic and science coexist.

item.title: Simulation Theory and Dimensions: Are We Just a Level?
item.description: Discover the science and theory behind simulation and dimensions. Inspired by Levels (2024), explore if we’re just part of a digital design.

item.title: Why You Still Exist in Universes Where You Were Never Born
item.description: Quantum theory supports parallel universes and quantum identity—revealing why you still exist in timelines where you were never born.

item.title: Steam, Faith, and the Vanishing Library: Hero of Alexandria’s Real Machines—and What the World Lost - Science Fiction Remnant
item.description: Two thousand years ago, Hero of Alexandria built steam-powered engines, coin-operated machines, and automated temple doors—technologies that wouldn’t reappear for centuries. When the Library of Alexandria burned, humanity lost more than books—we lost a head start on modern science.

item.title: The Computer of Tomorrow Is Already Here - Science Fiction Remnant
item.description: From Star Trek to Babylon 5, science fiction imagined computers that needed no keyboards, no screens, and no delays—only a voice, a gesture, or even a mood. Today, with AI and smart systems, that once-distant vision is closer to reality than we think.

item.title: Beyond the Circuits: Remembering the Human Condition in an Age of Sci-Fi Realities - Science Fiction Remnant
item.description: The paradox of advancing technology juxtaposes human fragility and unchanging nature. While tools like CRISPR and neurotechnology offer transformative power, they challenge our ethical boundaries and personal identity. We must strive to remember our roots and the significance of being human, ensuring we guide our inventions rather than being controlled by them.

item.title: Sword Art Online - Science Fiction Remnant
item.description: The article by Giancarlo Correa explores the impact of virtual reality (VR) on the human mind, particularly through the lens of the anime Sword Art Online. It discusses cognitive effects of extended VR use, identity crises, moral dilemmas, and emotional bonds in a digital context, highlighting both scientific research and philosophical questions.

item.title: The Enigma of Motoko Kusanagi in Ghost in the Shell - Science Fiction Remnant
item.description: In Ghost in the Shell, the notion of the "Ghost" represents a transcendent aspect of consciousness. The Ghost is the essence that distinguishes individuals, human or AI, from mere data or programming.
